notes.title: Frank and Drake at PAX East!
notes.content:
[b]PAX East 2023[/b] is here and with that one of the coolest booths of the show: the delightful [b]Chorus Café![/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/gBZsvAS.png[/img]

[b]'Frank and Drake'[/b] will be part of it along with other titles of Chorus, please be sure to check them and feel free to follow / wishlist to show your support!

[list]
[*][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1293910/Read_Only_Memories_NEURODIVER/][b]NEURODIVER[/b] [/url]by Midboss
[*][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1909750/Last_Time_I_Saw_You/][b]Last Time I Saw You[/b][/url]  by Maboroshi Artworks
[*][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1933180/Varney_Lake/][b]Varney Lake[/b][/url] by LCB Game Studio
[*][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1663220/Coffee_Talk_Episode_2_Hibiscus__Butterfly/][b]Coffee Talk Ep. 2 Hibiscus & Butterfly[/b] [/url]by Toge productions
[*][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1983300/Paper_Ghost_Stories_Third_Eye_Open/][b]Paper Ghost Stories: Third eye open[/b][/url] by Cellar Vault Games
[/list]

[b]Chorus Café booth number is 15115[/b]. They have different giveaways going, so if you're attending PAX don't hesitate to come by!

Enjoy your cup of hot coffee and great indie games with it! Below some pictures from day 1 : )


[img]https://i.imgur.com/4mkn8ZM.jpg[/img]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/BsAbD7D.jpg[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZPyeLyB.jpg[/img]

PS. All games featured on the Steam PAX feature [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/paxeast23]here[/url].

notes.title: ORIGINAL ARTWORK TO BE WON!
notes.content:
🎄 [b]ASTONISHING ORIGINAL ART TO BE WON![/b] 🎄

Enter now for a chance to win something very special: [b]a bespoke, rotoscoped portrait of YOU, done by the artists working on Frank and Drake![/b] The prize will be a 2-second animation based on the footage provided by the winner. An exclusive opportunity to win unique, exclusive and customised piece of art!

[list]

[/list]

Thank you and Happy Holidays from Apprnormals Team and Chorus Worldwide!

notes.title: Devs let's play: celebrating Indie Arena Booth!
notes.content:
[b]Indie Arena Booth[/b] starts today and we're part of it, so you can imagine how excited we are! 
We'll do a number of streams with different members of the team these days, playing the demo and explaining more about the game. We'll start tonight with the first broadcast at 10:30 pm CEST!

Here's a list with a few things you can do to support us:
[list]
[*] Watch us play and know more about the game.
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1530800/Frank_and_Drake/]Download the demo[/url] and experience it for yourself!
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1530800/Frank_and_Drake/]Wishlist[/url] and follow the game.
[/list]
We look forward to meeting you at the [b]Summercamp of Doom[/b].
Thank you ^^
